generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: flowers perfect, perigynous; calyx 5-lobed; petals commonly 5; ovary partly or wholly inferior, or superior, so its position is each genus's. Family summaries (as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read): carpels usually 2, joined below; Tolmiea is bilaterally symmetric.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 300 Saxifragaceae (in the narrow sense APG also takes): herbs, little or not at all succulent; leaves alternate, without stipules; fruit a capsule with many small seeds.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Saxifragaceae with Escalloniaceae, Penthoraceae, Vahliaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other. Its flowers are not mostly zygomorphic, so a plant of it states its own symmetry; one that is zygomorphic draws this kind, and one stating none is drawn regular.

traits.leaf_division.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Saxifragaceae with Penthoraceae, which APG and WCVP join to it (their extra states read as sometimes): leaves simple usually, compound rarely; the simple blade lobed often, none often; lobes or leaflets pinnate sometimes, palmate usually. Read from the coded leaf form and dissection by script (spec-rework/b1/delta).
